description: California DRE real estate licence lookup (official public licence records): by licence ID get licence type, name, mailing address, status, expiration and issue dates, former names, responsible broker, disciplinary/public comments; or search by licensee/company name (optional city) for matching licence IDs, names, licence types and cities. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
